name: Cannon
_hpNote: Structure health. Towers are destructible (ADR-0006) -- gold spent can be lost, which is what stops income compounding into permanent power.
_repairNote: Percent of the sell-and-rebuild cost to repair from zero to full. Same value as the arrow tower on purpose: this slice sweeps one knob, not a per-tower matrix. Differentiating maintenance cost by archetype is a later pass (sapper-tuning).
_upgradeRule: Rising cost, FALLING damage-per-gold. Building must stay the efficient play while good spots remain, or mazing stops mattering (design spec, The central tension).
_untuned: Placeholder values. No balance pass has run. See content-data/docs/balance-targets.md.
